# Waqt Money

> Fast, Paperless Instant Personal Loans & MSME Business Credit Lines in India.

Waqt Money is a digital lending platform operating in partnership with RBI-registered NBFC Waqt Finance Pvt Ltd (RBI License No. B.10.00143).

## Key Financial Services
- [Instant Personal Loans](https://waqtmoney.com/loans/personal-loan): Unsecured personal loans up to ₹5,00,000 for salaried professionals with 5-minute approval.
- [MSME Business Loans](https://waqtmoney.com/loans/business-loan): Working capital credit lines up to ₹50,00,000 without collateral.
- [Payday Cash Advance](https://waqtmoney.com/loans/payday-loan): Short-term salary advance loans for immediate financial needs.
- [Property Loans](https://waqtmoney.com/loans/loan-against-property): Secured loans against residential or commercial real estate.
- [EMI Calculator](https://waqtmoney.com/emi-calculator): Interactive loan EMI calculator for principal, interest, and tenure.

## Blog & Financial Guides
- [Blog Masterclass](https://waqtmoney.com/blog): Comprehensive financial literacy articles and loan guides.
